# Add-ZbxHostGroupMember

## SYNOPSIS

Adds hosts to a host group.

## SYNTAX

```
Add-ZbxHostGroupMember [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Group] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Add-ZbxHostGroupMember cmdlet adds the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts) to the host group in -Group with host.massadd; each host keeps the groups it is already in. Every host the pipeline brings is added in one call when the pipeline ends. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the hosts back and writes them. It needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Add a host to a group

```powershell
Add-ZbxHostGroupMember -InputObject 'db-01' -Group 'Web servers'
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes a host name, id or object, and -Group (position 1) the group's name, id or object.

### Example 2: Add every host a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-*' | Add-ZbxHostGroupMember -Group 'Linux servers' -PassThru | Select-Object TechnicalName, HostId
```

Get-ZbxHost writes host objects, and the command adds them all in one host.massadd. -PassThru writes the hosts back.
